step1_analysis.description: A 3rd-order passive low-pass loop filter used in a phase-locked loop (PLL). It integrates charge pump current pulses to generate a smooth DC control voltage for the VCO, while providing necessary poles and zeros for loop stability and spur suppression.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz 2.5-mA CMOS Frequency Synthesizer with an Automatic SC Tuning Loop

Tuning_Range.description: Overall frequency tuning range of the synthesizer (applies to full PLL)

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the switched-capacitor varactor bank sizing in the VCO.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 20% tuning range is standard for wideband LC VCOs to cover process variations.

sky130_expected.calculation: Kept intentionally low in the paper to improve noise.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low Kvco reduces AM-to-PM noise conversion and reference spurs.

Phase_Noise.description: Phase noise at 100kHz offset (applies to full PLL)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by VCO tank Q and loop filter noise contribution.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 inductors have moderate Q; achieving -102 dBc/Hz at 900MHz is feasible.

Reference_Spurs.description: Spurious tones at the reference frequency offset (applies to full PLL)

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on the high-frequency attenuation of this loop filter.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 3rd pole in the loop filter (R3, C3) is critical for suppressing these spurs.

Supply_Current.description: Total current consumption of the synthesizer

sky130_expected.reasoning: At 1.8V in SKY130, current might need to be slightly higher to maintain the same gm and phase noise performance as a 3V 0.6um process.

Transimpedance_10kHz.description: Magnitude of the loop filter transimpedance at 10kHz

sky130_expected.calculation: At 10kHz, impedance is typically dominated by R2. Z ≈ R2 = 15kΩ. 20*log10(15000) ≈ 83.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sets the loop bandwidth and damping factor.

Phase_100kHz.description: Phase of the loop filter transimpedance at 100kHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase transitions between the zero and higher-order poles.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Crucial for ensuring adequate phase margin (typically 50-60 degrees) for the PLL.

Attenuation_1MHz.description: Magnitude of the loop filter transimpedance at 1MHz (reference frequency)

sky130_expected.calculation: High frequency impedance dominated by total capacitance. Z ≈ 1 / (2*pi*1MHz*230pF) ≈ 700 Ω ≈ 57 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher attenuation at the reference frequency directly reduces reference spurs.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the AC transimpedance magnitude and phase of the passive loop filter. Dummy variables are included to print the full-PLL metrics reported in the paper, as they cannot be simulated on a standalone passive filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PLL Loop Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Filter Component Parameters (Typical for ~100kHz Loop BW)
.param C1_val=20p
.param C2_val=200p
.param R2_val=15k
.param R3_val=10k
.param C3_val=10p

* DUT: 3rd-Order Passive Loop Filter
C1 CP_OUTPUT GND {C1_val}
C2 CP_OUTPUT N1 {C2_val}
R2 N1 GND {R2_val}
R3 CP_OUTPUT VCO {R3_val}
C3 VCO GND {C3_val}

* Supply (Unused by passive filter, included for completeness)
Vdd VDD GND 1.8

* Stimulus: 1A AC current source to measure transimpedance directly as voltage
I1 GND CP_OUTPUT AC 1

.control
* AC Analysis from 100 Hz to 100 MHz
ac dec 100 100 100MEG

* Calculate Magnitude (dB) and Phase (degrees)
let z_mag_db = vdb(VCO)
let z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VCO))

* Measure Loop Filter AC Metrics
meas ac Transimpedance_10kHz find z_mag_db at=10k
meas ac Phase_100kHz find z_phase at=100k
meas ac Attenuation_1MHz find z_mag_db at=1Meg

* Dummy assignments for full-PLL metrics reported in the paper
let Tuning_Range = 20
let VCO_Gain = 20
let Phase_Noise = -102
let Reference_Spurs = -55
let Supply_Current = 2.5m

* Print all metrics
print Transimpedance_10kHz Phase_100kHz Attenuation_1MHz
print Tuning_Range VCO_Gain Phase_Noise Reference_Spurs Supply_Current

quit
.endc
